treatyPosition.currentStance: Japan supports a legally binding global plastics treaty but has favored a focus on waste management and downstream measures over upstream production caps. It coordinates closely with other consumer-economy negotiating partners.
treatyPosition.inc52Position: At the resumed INC-5.2 in Geneva (August 2025), Japan continued to support a treaty but did not align with the High Ambition Coalition's call for a binding cap on primary plastic polymer production. The session ended without a final agreed text.

historicalRounds.position: Engaged constructively; emphasized full lifecycle approach with strong waste-management language; did not endorse a binding production cap.

domesticPolicies.name: Plastic Resource Circulation Act (プラスチック資源循環促進法)
domesticPolicies.summary: Promotes design-for-recycling, expanded sorted collection of plastic waste by municipalities, and obligations on businesses to reduce single-use plastic. Sets a framework for the 3Rs+Renewable across the plastics lifecycle.
